turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling Verizon, this is Maya. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, um, yeah, I was looking at my bill and I think I got charged twice for, uh, the TravelPass?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry about that. Let me pull that up. Can you confirm the billing zip code on the account?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sure, it's zero seven three zero two.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I do see two TravelPass charges. Do you remember which days you were abroad?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Oh, let me think, I was in Toronto for like three days and I only turned it on once, I mean I think I only turned it on once, and then the second—

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sorry to jump in, was that trip in October?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Got it. The second charge is a duplicate, so I'll reverse it right now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Oh great, thank you so much, that's, uh, really helpful.
